messages:
Mae: Heads up — started seeing spikes of mTLS failures in apac at ~16:42 UTC, internal service calls returning 502/524. Any idea?
Liam: Yep, logs show repeated KMS decrypt denys during cert fetch from rotator. Sample log: KMS Decrypt Deny principal=svc-proxy-apac key=keystore-main req=0x9f3
Tasha: That region had an RBAC prune last night as part of the permission hardening. Could be related.
Mae: rotator-bot: no ephemeral cert renewals from proxies-apac since 16:40. oncall-bot: INC-20260324-042 created.
Liam: Quick mitigation — rebind keystore-unwrap role to proxy SA, restart rotator on canary nodes, replay audit-forwarder.
Tasha: Applying temp RoleBinding (15m) and adding a canary keystore unwrap probe into the rollout job.
Mae: After RBAC bind + rotator restart handshakes recovered ~16:48 UTC. Need to backfill missing audit records for compliance.
Liam: Adding alert: KMS Decrypt Deny count by region+role > 4 in 5m -> page eng-security.
Tasha: Follow-ups: add audit-forwarder healthcheck to RBAC rollout checklist, add keystore-smoke test to rotator canary, update postmortem template. I'll own the writeup.
Mae: Thanks — leaving incident open until audit backfill confirmed. :white_check_mark:
